recentItems.title: NBC Nightly News with Tom Llamas Full Episode - Sept. 18
recentItems.description:
Tonight: President Trump banned CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House for what he called one-sided coverage. Trump also warned “other outlets” would “follow” but did not specify which. The news broke right as Trump announces a deal that gives the U.S. over permanent security in Greenland. Plus, police say three juveniles have been arrested after a female college student was thrown to the ground, kicked, punched, and pulled by the hair in the early hours of Saturday morning. Also, Princess Diana's brother Charles Spencer is doubling down on claims about King Charles in his upcoming memoir. In a new interview, he says he's "telling the truth” about a call with then-Prince Charles after Diana’s death. And in tonight's 'Great Americans' Cheryl Schreier was the first female superintendent of the iconic American landmark, Mount Rushmore National Memorial. She dedicated her life to public service, working for the National Park Service for nearly four decades. Schreier reflects on her most memorable moments at Mt. Rushmore, and how she hopes her impact extends far beyond the parks.
